Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
While the equinox marks the time of year when foil and non-foil are equal in the sky, there are some more drawn to the resplendence of foils. For them, this bundle includes only the scintillating foil cards that warm us with their luminous shine.
Contents:
• 1x Secret Lair x Fallout®: Vault Boy Rainbow Foil Edition
• 1x Secret Lair x Fallout®: Points of Interest Rainbow Foil Edition
• 1x Secret Lair x Fallout®: S.P.E.C.I.A.L. Rainbow Foil Edition
• 1x Featuring: Phoebe Wahl Rainbow Foil Edition
• 1x Diabolical Dioramas Rainbow Foil Edition
• 1x Artist Series: Rovina Cai Rainbow Foil Edition
